high_level_description: The image shows a mannequin dressed in an elaborate green Versace dress. The dress features a deep V-neckline that extends well past the navel, revealing a significant portion of the chest area. The fabric appears to have a bamboo pattern, adding texture and visual interest to the garment. The waist of the dress is adorned with citrines, which are small, faceted gemstones, adding a touch of sparkle and elegance. The mannequin is positioned against a plain, light-colored background, which helps to highlight the dress's vibrant green color and intricate details.
